issueSummary: The Wix homepage has real local contact/service info but loses trust through template leftovers, fake testimonials, vague CTAs, thin service descriptions, and no clear estimate flow.
topFindings: Critical trust damage from Wix/template leftovers and placeholder testimonials.
Hero CTA is generic instead of driving a free estimate request.
Services and quote process need clearer homeowner decision paths.
preservedDesign: Kept the Wix-style single-page rhythm, garden imagery, serif headline feel, simple centered sections, natural/sage color direction, and original contact details while lightly cleaning trust and conversion copy.
criticalCoverageStatus: All critical findings fixed or improved in the static prototype: fake/template content removed from the page experience and the hero now drives a specific free-estimate CTA.
